mutation_catalog.M01_MISSING_KEY: delete each required key in turn
mutation_catalog.M02_EXTRA_KEY: add an unregistered authority key at each object depth
mutation_catalog.M03_WRONG_KEY_SAME_COUNT: rename a required key while preserving object cardinality
mutation_catalog.M04_DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY: inject a duplicate key into serialized bytes
mutation_catalog.M05_NONFINITE_JSON: inject NaN, Infinity, and -Infinity into numeric locations
mutation_catalog.M06_BOOL_FOR_INT: substitute true/false for every integer authority field
mutation_catalog.M07_FLOAT_INT_ALIAS: substitute numerically equal float for every integer authority field
mutation_catalog.M08_INT_FLOAT_ALIAS: substitute numerically equal integer for every field declared float-only
mutation_catalog.M09_INT_OR_FLOAT_FOR_BOOL: substitute 0, 1, 0.0, or 1.0 for every boolean authority field
mutation_catalog.M10_IDENTITY_OR_CLAIM: alter schema, status, classification, role, packet, or claim boundary
mutation_catalog.M11_HASH_OR_PATH: bit-flip hash; change path; use absolute escape or traversal
mutation_catalog.M12_SYMLINK_OR_WRITABLE: replace file/root with symlink or writable object and inject an ancestor rename-plus-symlink during owner-once publication
mutation_catalog.M13_DESCRIPTOR_TOCTOU: replace/truncate/rewrite path or descriptor during authentication/use
mutation_catalog.M14_COUNT_ARITHMETIC: zero, negative, omitted, extra, or sum/magnitude-mismatched count
mutation_catalog.M15_LIST_CENSUS_ORDER: duplicate, omit, reorder, or add list member/length/role
mutation_catalog.M16_CROSS_ROLE_ALIAS: reuse a path or digest across target/hostile or evidence roles
mutation_catalog.M17_PROVENANCE_DROP_SWAP: remove, stale, cross-bind, or swap a transitive hash
mutation_catalog.M18_CACHE_CENSUS_SEMANTICS: alter file census, dtype, shape, bytes, ordering, offsets, rank, XOR, admission, or lineage mapping
mutation_catalog.M19_STAGE_BYPASS: present later-stage authority while predecessor is absent/failed or authorize wrong L
mutation_catalog.M20_HISTORY_PROJECTION: alter canonical deterministic history field, row census, comparison, or tolerance edge
mutation_catalog.M21_TERMINAL_SHARD: alter q order, path root, shape, bytes, hash, mode, or shard descriptor
mutation_catalog.M22_RESOURCE_FRESHNESS: alter resource arithmetic/limit, pressure, timestamp, filesystem, or threshold boundary
mutation_catalog.M23_HANDSHAKE_TELEMETRY: exceed skew/sample interval; omit/extra role/field; mismatch epoch, exit code, or output hash
mutation_catalog.M24_UNLOCK_AUDIT_BINDING: drop or swap execution authorization, promotion audit, or stage audit digest
mutation_catalog.M25_IMPORT_TARGET_VALIDATOR: import/call target validator or dynamic target module and require audit self-refusal
mutation_catalog.M26_L10_CROSS_MISMATCH: change one target/hostile L10 deterministic value, tolerance, role hash, or PASS count
mutation_catalog.M27_L12_CROSS_MISMATCH: change one target/hostile L12 output/hash/comparison value or substitute an incomplete output
mutation_catalog.M28_PREMATURE_ARTIFACT: create a gate/cache/workspace/history/telemetry before its authorized stage
mutation_catalog.M29_WRONG_ABSENCE_VALUE: change required false absence value to true, 0, or 0.0
mutation_catalog.M30_COMPLETION_BOOL_PROCESS_ID: substitute a boolean for the worker-completion process ID
mutation_catalog.M31_COMPLETION_FLOAT_PROCESS_ID: substitute a numerically equal float for the worker-completion process ID
mutation_catalog.M33_COMPLETION_OUTPUT_HASH: alter the authenticated worker-completion output digest
mutation_catalog.M35_COMPLETION_STAGE_BYPASS: admit worker completion before both release ACKs
mutation_catalog.M36_COMPLETION_EPOCH_WINDOW: move worker completion outside its authenticated execution wall window
